title: 20-Year-Old Shoplifters Flee Police With a Flat Tire
description:
This deputy just noticed 20 year old girls fleeing in a vehicle with a stolen licence plate. It was surprising even to the officers that the girls continued driving despite their tires being completely flat. One of the officers checked their car, and here’s what he found. Shekeria was charged with Fleeing/Eluding at a high speed and reckless driving while Amber was charged with shoplifting. 
#news
